versions.changelog:
Initial release of seo-expert, an SEO & GEO expert assistant.

- Provides a knowledge base of 200+ curated articles in Chinese, covering keyword research, on-page optimization, backlinks, technical SEO, GEO, and monetization.
- Includes 5 guided workflows: new site SEO launch, competitor analysis, backlink strategy, technical SEO audit, and AI tool site go-global playbook.
- Features bilingual triggers for common SEO and GEO use cases.
- Offers quick access to core SEO frameworks, guided checklists, and actionable strategies.
